title: Optimization provenance view
description: Show how a value was produced, e.g. v3 = imul_imm v2, 2 -> constant folded to iconst.i64 84. Public info only: tag every input instruction with a unique SourceLoc before Context::optimize, read the tags back from the optimized function, and map surviving instructions to their origin. Where a tag does not survive, report 'no provenance available' rather than guess. The first piece of work is an empirical check of which rewrites (folds, GVN, DCE, LICM) preserve srclocs; record the result in the bead notes. Do not reconstruct provenance by pattern-matching on our own.
acceptance_criteria: Covered by .clif fixtures with check: lines via the fixture harness (cargo test --test fixtures); no unit tests.
notes: Empirical srcloc check (cranelift 0.136.2, opt_level=speed, every input inst tagged @N, probe = throwaway example). SURVIVE: GVN keeps the first of duplicates (second tag gone, no pointer to the survivor); LICM hoists with tags intact; brif folded to jump keeps its tag (opcode changed); an inst whose operands were simplified keeps its tag (iadd v0,v2 -> iadd v0,v11). LOST: any inst created by a rewrite gets the default srcloc (imul of consts -> iconst 84; imul 8 -> ishl; udiv 4 -> ushr); egraph clones of constants/iadd/icmp rematerialized into a loop body get none. REMOVED insts (DCE, GVN dup, identity fold, bnot bnot, select of const) simply vanish with no record of why or into what. So reachable: per output inst -> original inst when tag survives (+ whether its text changed); per original inst -> gone; output inst with default srcloc -> 'no provenance available'. NOT reachable: which rule fired, folded 'imul_imm v2,2 -> iconst 84' as one step (new iconst is untagged). imul_imm/iadd_imm/udiv_imm no longer exist in 0.136.2, so use iconst+op in examples.
close_reason: Provenance view added; empirical srcloc findings in bead notes
